pf.services.capacity: One estimator or planner per booking; one machine crew per job; the office's design table is saved with long sessions
pf.services.skills: Estimates and running a job: site leads. Site consults: site planners. Trucking, drilling and septic: subcontractors.
pf.services.nobody_home: Estimates and fill deliveries: nobody needs to be home if the gate is open. Dig days: an adult on the booking is reachable by phone.
pf.services.online: A site consult can be a video or phone call (counts as at the office)
pf.services.smallest_job: A switch the owner sets: the smallest job taken, with smaller requests pointed elsewhere (the example takes no dig under half a day).

studio: Which area, and a rough budget (on the secure page)

stop.words: gas smell near a dig, hissing near a gas line, sparking or smoking wires, a carbon monoxide alarm
stop.says: Leave the house now. Then call 911 and the gas or power company.
stop.booking: no booking; a new request must say the site was made safe

stop.words: a trench wall caving in, a person trapped in a hole, ground giving way
stop.says: Keep everyone away from the edge, and call 911 right away.

steps_then_go_on.words: water running toward the house or standing against a wall
steps_then_go_on.says: Keep away from wet outlets and switches. We'll look at it first.

steps_then_go_on.words: a washout or a sinking spot that people could fall into
steps_then_go_on.says: Mark it, keep people and pets away, and we'll look at it first.

pf.safety.business_line: Questions about digging near a neighbor's fence, a septic system, a well or a wall's footing go to the business's own line

pf.first_steps.before_quote: The estimate visit at the property, with everyone who will sign there
after_contract: The cancel window ends before any work or orders, where the state's rules give one

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Office: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator walks the site, measures, photographs and notes the slope and water paths; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days
pf.visit.changes: A written change order, priced and signed by both, before any changed work. Rock, soft ground, roots or buried tanks are priced this way.
pf.visit.outside_checks: An erosion control check before the dig and a final grade check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final grade check where needed, then the walk-through and punch list, then DONE on the last work day; the care notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the site planner's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The area, slopes, low spots, and anything nearby that could be hit (fences, sheds, trees, sprinklers)

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the digging and grading, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through and the final grade check
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the site lead texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The site plan session's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Site leads (Boris, Rafa): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Site planners (Greta, Sol) at the office.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another site lead may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its site lead unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final grade check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's). Settling of loose fill in the first months is normal; the contract says what is covered.

pf.edges.weather: Heavy rain or frozen ground on a dig day: the work moves, with no fee; the site lead checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.machine_down: A machine breaks down: the crew swaps it or moves the day, with no fee to the customer
pf.edges.machine_cannot_reach: The machine can't reach the work: the site lead calls Alex first; hand work or a smaller machine goes on a change order
pf.edges.hidden_conditions: Rock, soft ground, roots or a buried tank found in the dig: a change order before the fix
pf.edges.line_in_the_way: A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it and digs by hand near it; the start may move a day or two
pf.edges.contaminated_soil: Oil or other soil problems found: the crew stops, and Alex is told in writing; removal is a separate job by a licensed firm
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.fill_settles: Loose fill settles; the quote says how long to wait before building on it
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates and fill deliveries with the gate open, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer, video; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Boris's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $1,400 to start, $8,400 when the digging and grading are done, $4,200 at the finish (a $14,000 lot grading). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true; a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Drainage trench, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit). Left out: list paths. Fill delivery ($179) and Culvert cleaning ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Site Office, a site office (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 site consult with Greta, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the office desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (site plan session, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (grading and drainage plan package, $140, $40 deposit).
Flow A can be a video or phone site consult (fact `video`): the owner's plot plan and photos are enough to talk through a grading plan, so the A4-01 video branch is on.
Own steps: A8-x01 (the site consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and the utility locate go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; a marked line in the way means re-planning the dig) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (a large rock in the dig: a change order first, signed by both).
Digging starts only after buried lines are marked (the utility locate is a first step, B8-x06), a gas smell near a dig or a trench wall caving in is a stop with 911 first (pf.safety), a buried tank is a stop with a written note (B8-30: stops and sends a written note), and rock, soft ground and roots are change orders (pf.edges hidden_conditions).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Boris and Rafa are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Greta and Sol the site planners (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 700 Depot Rd (the company), 33 Court St (the office), 6 Hillcrest Dr (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (EX-00123, HL-00456, SO-00789).
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
keep: color (a real word of this work), the estimate visit (the trade's own word), leak and valve (the master's safety examples), roofing (the work it doesn't do), drain (a real word here).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); 'cut' and 'hair' words that the master uses for its barbershop are turned into this work's words or removed (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34).
